caption:
Your revenue number hides the real story.

Four numbers tell you if your pipeline is healthy or quietly leaking jobs:

1. Leads in this week, every channel, counted once
2. Average response time, lead in to first contact out
3. Stuck leads, anyone untouched for 3+ days
4. Win rate on contacted leads, not all leads, just the ones you actually followed up with

Run this every Friday for a month. You'll see the leak before it shows up in next month's revenue.

See all four, live, in one pipeline. 14 days free.
